paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: First axion dark matter search using a JTWPA, operated on the ADMX 'sidecar' cavity. Paper excludes axion-photon couplings above ~1e-13 GeV^-1 over 4796.7-4799.5 MHz (axion masses ~19.840-19.852 ueV, centered at 19.84 ueV). Exact frequency-dependent limit values are only shown in Fig. 7 (not tabulated), so the limit is encoded as a flat two-point bound at the abstract's quoted value of 1e-13 GeV^-1 across the stated frequency range. Assumes axions constitute all local DM with density 0.45 GeV/cm^3, Maxwell-Boltzmann line shape.
